newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products-Light ends ride gasoline coattail.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products-Light ends ride gasoline coattail.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady to higher with some boost from the seasonal gasoline market.
Naphtha ended steady with traders looking to firm gasoline to compensate for ample supplies and weak end-user demand.
Gasoline barges rose $2 with traders banking on an open arbitrage and rising seasonal demand to lift prices.
Gas oil was pulled $3 higher by stronger futures and firm premiums. Diesel remains tight, underpinning strong premiums.
Low sulphur markets digested Tuesday's blizzard of deals while swaps jumped $3. High sulphur cargoes and barges were dormant, with most traders on holiday.
